caption:
Most shops track what they spend on ads.

Few can say what it actually returned.

The Ad ROI Calculator takes four numbers, ad spend, leads, close rate, average job value, and turns them into a cost-per-lead and return estimate.

No signup. No card. Just the math, before you approve next month's spend.
